text: Innovation Accelerator or “Venus Flytrap” Strategy? The Antitrust Perspective on Open Source AI Regulation presents the following source proposition: We find that open source does not inherently facilitate monopolization. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that The success of the open source movement itself creates a vulnerability: major corporations can pressure smaller projects to reveal their code, then take it and exploit the work more profitably than the startup can.
